opening: I keep getting bouts of fever that come and go.
I get a red rash that is tender to the touch.
This has been happening for about 2 years.
Before a flare starts, I feel like I'm coming down with the flu.
Before a flare I get a sore throat.
Before a flare my joints ache.

opening.text: I keep getting bouts of fever that come and go, and I get a red rash that is tender to the touch. This has been happening for about 2 years. Before a flare starts, I feel like I'm coming down with the flu, I get a sore throat, and my joints ache. I've also taken prednisone tablets.
